en.hubeali: From him, from Al Washha, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Do not burn the papers, but delete these and (then) burn them’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from al-Washsha’from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “
I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘Do not burn the papers, but wipe or wash them away and then you may burn them.’”
